title: Impartus experimental OpenTUI session protocol
description: Single Go-owned source of truth for the private impartus <-> impartus-ui session contract. Go DTOs and TypeScript protocol types are generated from this document; neither side hand-writes them.

Bootstrap.description: is the one-use private handoff from the Go parent to its OpenTUI child.

baseUrl.description: Loopback URL of this one foreground session. Never contains credentials.

capability.description: Fresh per-launch capability read once from an owner-private bootstrap file.

protocol.description: Exact session protocol identity the child must send.

sessionId.description: Opaque session identity used to reject stale bootstrap state.

HealthStatus.description: is the aggregate session readiness value. The session never reports which credentials are configured.

Health.description: is the session readiness probe answered before the frontend renders anything.

sessionId.description: Opaque per-launch session identity. Not a credential.

Course.description: is one read-only catalog course projected from the Go application service.

CourseList.description: is the read-only catalog projection proving the frontend reaches live Go state.

Diagnostic.description: is one non-blocking dependency or local-state preflight result already scrubbed by the Go parent.

status.description: Presentation status such as pass, warn, or fail.

DiagnosticList.description: contains startup diagnostics owned by the Go parent.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics in their stable collection order.

Lecture.description: is the presentation-safe subset of one live Impartus lecture.

noAudio.description: Whether upstream marks this lecture as lacking audio.

startTime.description: Lecture start time as supplied upstream.

subjectName.description: Course name reported on the lecture.

views.description: Number of camera views advertised upstream.

LectureList.description: contains the live lectures for one requested course identity.

lectures.description: Lectures in the application service order.

LectureIdentity.description: is the minimal authoritative identity accepted for lecture mutations. The Go parent re-resolves the full live lecture before acting.

ArtifactSummary.description: is one presentation-safe local library record without exposing filesystem paths.

fileCount.description: Number of materialized files recorded for the artifact.

presentFileCount.description: Number of recorded files currently marked present.

topic.description: Lecture topic stored in the manifest.

totalBytes.description: Total recorded bytes across materialized files.

ArtifactList.description: contains the current durable local lecture library.

artifacts.description: Artifacts newest first in the store order.

OperationKind.description: names the operations the session may start. The bounded foundation exposes only a transport self test.

OperationState.description: is one operation lifecycle state. Every state except running is terminal.

OperationRequest.description: is the request body accepted when starting an operation.

lecture.description: Lecture identity required by lecture-scoped operations.

resume.description: Whether playback should use an existing durable resume checkpoint when available.

PlaybackCommandAction.description: names one bounded mpv control owned by the Go playback session.

PlaybackCommand.description: is one typed playback-control request. The action determines whether flag or value is required.

flag.description: Boolean value used by pause and mute.

value.description: Numeric value used by seek, volume, and speed.

Operation.description: is the handle returned when an operation is accepted or inspected.

EventType.description: names the ordered session event kinds delivered over the event stream.

Event.description: is one ordered session event. Sequence numbers increase monotonically per session.

message.description: Scrubbed human readable detail. Never carries upstream credentials.

muted.description: Current playback mute state when known.

paused.description: Current playback pause state when known.

operationId.description: Operation this event belongs to, when the event is operation scoped.

volume.description: Current playback volume percentage when known.

Problem.description: is the uniform session error body. It never discloses local state or credentials.

supportedProtocol.description: Protocol identity this session speaks, sent with protocol upgrade failures.
